name: musclemap-nifti
label: MuscleMap
description: Runs Neurodesk MuscleMap on the first NIfTI file in a scan-level NIFTI resource or xnat2bids-staged MR session and stores the derived segmentation in XNAT.
command-line: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; input="$(find -L /input -type f \( -iname "*.nii" -o -iname "*.nii.gz" \) | sort | head -n 1)"; if [ -z "$input" ]; then echo "No NIfTI file found in /input" >&2; exit 2; fi; case "$MUSCLEMAP_BODY_REGION" in wholebody|abdomen|forearm|pelvis|thigh|leg) ;; *) echo "Invalid MuscleMap body region: $MUSCLEMAP_BODY_REGION" >&2; exit 2;; esac; case "$MUSCLEMAP_USE_GPU" in Y|N) ;; *) echo "Invalid MuscleMap GPU flag: $MUSCLEMAP_USE_GPU" >&2; exit 2;; esac; if ! printf "%s" "$MUSCLEMAP_SPATIAL_OVERLAP" | grep -Eq "^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$"; then echo "Invalid MuscleMap spatial overlap: $MUSCLEMAP_SPATIAL_OVERLAP" >&2; exit 2; fi; mm_segment -i "$input" -o /output -r "$MUSCLEMAP_BODY_REGION" -c "$MUSCLEMAP_CHUNK_SIZE" -s "$MUSCLEMAP_SPATIAL_OVERLAP" -g "$MUSCLEMAP_USE_GPU"'

inputs.name: body-region
inputs.label: Body region
inputs.description: MuscleMap model region. Supported values: wholebody, abdomen, forearm, pelvis, thigh, leg.

inputs.name: chunk-size
inputs.label: Chunk size
inputs.description: Number of axial slices per inference chunk, or auto.

inputs.name: use-gpu
inputs.label: Use GPU
inputs.description: Use CUDA when the Docker host has a compatible GPU runtime.

xnat.name: musclemap-dicom-scan
xnat.label: MuscleMap
xnat.description: Convert this scan's DICOM resource to NIfTI with dcm2niix, then run Neurodesk MuscleMap on it

external-inputs.name: scan
external-inputs.description: Input scan with a DICOM resource.

derived-inputs.name: scan-dicoms
derived-inputs.description: The scan-level DICOM resource, converted to NIfTI by the dcm2niix setup command before it is mounted.
